description:
Fables Mosaic: Cinderella features a collection of colourful puzzles that can be solved by logic alone! 
Follow the story of Cinderella while you solve captivating nonogram challenges!

- 100 unique nonogram levels
- Follow the story of Cinderella
- View a gallery of completed nonograms
- Use logic to solve puzzles
name: Fables Mosaic: Cinderella
intro: Experience Cinderella story through logic puzzles!
